# External performance evidence

This directory contains reproducible inputs and recorded observations from
third-party simulators. External measurements answer comparative engineering
questions, but they are not interchangeable with same-host native regression
baselines.

Each study owns its decks, method, provenance limitations, reproduction steps,
and interpretation. New evidence must identify simulator versions and binary
digests, host configuration, raw observations, normalization, and uncertainty.
Never overwrite an existing study result; add a dated revision and retain the
prior evidence.
